book.occultism_abyssal.covenant.name: Abyssal Covenant
book.occultism_abyssal.covenant.descript: A timed pentacle for Abyssal Mining devices and upgrades.
book.occultism_abyssal.covenant.layout: Build on a flat 11×11 floor. Put an Eldritch or Celestial Chalice at the center. Place Sacrificial Bowls five blocks away in each cardinal direction, and at (±4, ±4). Draw all intervening cardinal and diagonal spokes. Sneak-use void or rainbow chalk on the floor. Use the offhand, with an empty main hand, for the focus one block north of the chalice. Use the main hand for the other runes.
book.occultism_abyssal.covenant.crafting: Place one offering in each bowl. To fill the center, sneak-use an eligible chalice while holding the offering in the main hand. You may hold one extra offering in the offhand. Empty the main hand and sneak-use the chalice to begin or claim. The Abyssal Ancient Miner requires a player-killed Wither in range after starting. This timer runs while the structure is loaded.
book.occultism_abyssal.covenant.machines: Use nine sources, a shared output, and up to three cards of each supported type. Higher effective weapon damage and attack speed shorten the battlefield’s hit interval. Insert sources from above and pull from below. Purple runes enable the ritual, teal bars indicate progress, and amber bars indicate blocked output. JEI lists ritual ingredients and timing.
book.occultism_abyssal.abyss.setup: Preview and project the 19×19 pentacle on the next page. Use an Eldritch or Celestial Chalice, and void or rainbow chalk. Place offering bowls on open tiles at floor level.
book.occultism_abyssal.abyss.activation: Put separate ingredients in the outer bowls. Right-click the center chalice with a bound Marid Book of Binding. The chalice tracks the ritual and the timer.
book.occultism_abyssal.abyss.wither: Place ten bowls on open tiles in the 19×19 pentacle. Add offerings and start the ritual. Kill a Wither within range to begin the countdown. The chalice takes one offering at a time as the ritual advances.
ritual.occultism_abyssal.native_start: Use a bound Marid Book of Binding on the center chalice.

book.occultism_abyssal.abyss.maintenance: Combine a Looting Upgrade Card, a Bottle o’ Enchanting, and an Occultism Soul Gem in any crafting arrangement. Put the card in the battlefield’s Mend slot. Kill XP first repairs the weapon if it has Mending, restoring up to 2 durability per point. Every 10 surplus XP becomes a bottle.
